title: H-ROSTERTOOLTIP-1, two players: a merged partner's display copy of the owner's staff carries the owner's weekly hours and demand list (the two things the native employee tooltip reads besides name/skills/satisfaction), off the roster publish; ends dissolved, NO save
preconditions: Fixture save1. Build H-ROSTERTOOLTIP-1 deployed on both machines. FIXTURE REQUIREMENT: the HOST must own (truly, not merger-flipped) at least one shop with an employee who has scheduled hours (assignedWeeklyHours > 0), at least one assigned weekly day and at least one demand - step 14 discovers it with `rostertip pick` and the run is blocked if none exists. The rig draws no screen: `rostertip <address>` prints, for every employee at that address as THIS machine holds them, id:h=<assignedWeeklyHours>:d=<demands>:w=<assignedWeeklyDays as ints> (the fields EmployeeTooltip.cs:36/:44 read, plus the days DaysWorkingPerWeek/FreeOnDays read for the demand ticks, EmployeeTooltip.cs:80) plus an md5 sig of the sorted rows.

steps.note: the worlds settle and the first roster publishes cross
one full owner publish pass (30 s) plus one partner apply tick (10 s) after the settle, so a roster whose hours moved at load has crossed
THE SUBJECT: the first shop the host truly owns with a REAL employee who has scheduled hours AND demands
the OWNER's side: real records (injected=0), at least one with hours > 0 and a non-empty demand list

THE ASSERTION: the partner's DISPLAY copies (all injected) report the same ids, the same assignedWeeklyHours, the same demand list and the same assignedWeeklyDays, in order, as the owner's real records. Before H-ROSTERTOOLTIP-1 the copies held 0 hours and whatever demands the stand-in constructor rolled
FIXTURE HYGIENE: end dissolved; NO save
